items.title: The Toronto Raptors announced that they converted Nate Bittle to a two-way contract.
items.author: KeithSmithNBA
items.body_excerpt:
The Toronto Raptors announced that they converted Nate Bittle to a two-way contract.

The Raptors still have one two-way spot open.

Toronto also waived Nimari Burnett, Jalen Celestine, Tyson Degenhart, Tyreke Key and Jamarion Sharp.

items.title: The Raptors have converted Nate Bittle to a two-way.
items.author: Blake Murphy
items.body_excerpt:
The Raptors have converted Nate Bittle to a two-way.

They are keeping the other two-way open for now, with about 100 players expected to be cut around the league.

Burnett, Key, Sharp, Celestine, and Degenhart waived. Most of that group likely 905-bound if unclaimed.
